title: pyrethrum macrophyllum
intro: Pyrethrum macrophyllum, commonly known as Argentine daisy, is a flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family. It is prized for its flowers, which are rich in bioactive constituents, including pyrethrins, that provide various health benefits. The plant's pyrethrins have been traditionally used to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions, showcasing its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Pyrethrum macrophyllum, including flavonoids and sesquiterpene lactones, are also being researched for their potential antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
